verdict.rationale: Cerebras's own docs say existing applications can switch to Cerebras by changing the API key, base URL and model ID, and its product page advertises OpenAI API compatibility with 'just two code changes'. Standard OpenAI content shapes such as image_url are also documented as supported. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of a drop-in OpenAI SDK swap, and the docs note the model ID must also change, so it is not strictly base URL and key only.

support.subject: As a developer, I can point an existing OpenAI SDK client at the provider by changing only the base URL and API key

citations.quote: Existing applications can use Cerebras by changing the API key, base URL, and model ID.
OpenAI API compatibility lets developers build on Cerebras with just two code changes.
The standard OpenAI `image_url` content shape is supported.
